hook.en: Two businesses earn the same sales: one runs a city taxi app, the other makes a patented medicine. One fights for every rupee of profit, the other earns steady margins. Michael Porter explained why with five forces.

objectives.en: Name and explain Porter's five forces
Judge the attractiveness of an industry
Suggest how a firm can weaken a force

narration.en: Two businesses earn the same sales: one runs a city taxi app, the other makes a patented medicine. One fights for every rupee of profit, the other earns steady margins. Michael Porter explained why with five forces.

body.en: Michael Porter suggested that the profitability of an industry depends on five competitive forces. Threat of new entrants: easy entry brings new rivals. Bargaining power of suppliers: few suppliers of a key input can raise prices. Bargaining power of buyers: big or well-informed buyers can push prices down. Threat of substitutes: products from other industries that meet the same need cap the price. Rivalry among existing competitors: many equal rivals with slow growth and high fixed costs fight hard on price.

points.en: New entrants (barriers: scale, capital, brand, licences)

body.en: When all five forces are strong, profits are low and the industry is unattractive; when they are weak, profits can be high. A firm uses the analysis before entering an industry, and to find ways to protect itself: building a brand and loyalty to reduce buyer power and rivalry, long-term contracts or several suppliers to cut supplier power, and patents or scale to raise entry barriers.

problem.en: A firm plans to open a cement plant. Cement needs huge capital, limestone is available from many quarries, buyers are thousands of builders, there is no real substitute, and five large firms already compete. Assess the five forces.

steps.en: New entrants: weak, because huge capital is a barrier.
Suppliers: weak, since limestone is available from many quarries.
Buyers: weak to moderate; many small builders have little power.
Substitutes: weak. Rivalry: moderate to strong among five large firms.
Overall: forces are mostly weak, so the industry is fairly attractive, if the firm can raise the capital.

answer.en: Mostly weak forces except rivalry: a fairly attractive industry for a well-funded entrant.
